thread:
maria-p: Quick sync — we need to finalize redistribution language for the open-model consortium partners + marketplace listing + joint announce timeline.

noah-legal: Dropping in. Are we leaning permissive (SLA + attribution) or locked-down redistribution? Export + compliance will drive this.

aj-sales: Customers expect hosted + dedicated listings. Marketplace wants a single SKU and clear revenue split. :thinking_face:

sam-eng: From infra side, we need quantization/weights packaging notes so marketplace images can run on our Dedicated pools. Small JSON manifest works.

olivia-ops: Also need to confirm VPC/private deployment support and KMS integration for partners that require key isolation.

maria-p: Goal: one standard redistribution clause we can apply + a marketplace addendum for bundling (HW + SI) and geoblocks. Draft idea below.

maria-p: ```Redistribution: Provider grants Redwood a non-exclusive right to redistribute model weights for hosted, dedicated, and private deployments under agreed attribution. Customer-facing redistribution requires prior consent for export-restricted models.``` 

noah-legal: This is a decent start. Replace "redistribute" with "make available via service" and add export control sentence: `Partners must certify no embargoed territories.`

liam-marketing: For joint announce, we need a 3-week embargo window and a one-page partner brief + logos approval. Can marketing own the announcement checklist?

aj-sales: Marketplace revenue split proposal: 70/30 (partner/Redwood) for direct marketplace sales, with bulk reserved capacity negotiated separately.

sam-eng: Implementation flag: add `manifest.v1` with fields: `quantized: true|false`, `runtime: cuda-turing/rocm`, `kv_cache_compat: true`. Will that work for distribution packaging?

noah-legal: Add requirement: partner to provide evidence of third-party license compatibility (e.g., Apache/BSD) and a checksum for weights.

olivia-ops: Ops note: For SI bundles we need a support matrix: standard (30d email), premium (SLA phone + patches). We'll map SKUs accordingly.

maria-p: Action items:
- noah-legal: update clause + export line (ETA EOD Thurs)
- sam-eng: sketch manifest + packaging guide (ETA Tue)
- liam-marketing: draft announce checklist + logo consent flow (ETA Fri)
- aj-sales: confirm revenue split + reseller addendum (ETA Wed)

aj-sales: noted. I'll sync with finance and HW partner to confirm margins.

liam-marketing: I'll create a shared Notion doc and ping everyone when ready. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder: calendar invite created for "Partner Marketplace Kickoff" 2024-10-15 09:00 PT — attendees: maria-p, aj-sales, noah-legal, sam-eng, olivia-ops, liam-marketing.
